description: High-risk (A and V zones, including floodways), moderate-risk (shaded X, 0.2% annual chance) and undetermined (D) FEMA flood zones within a radius of a US address or point (default 500 m, up to 2000 m), with the straight-line distance to the nearest of each and their base flood elevations. Answers "how far is this house from the floodplain".

address.description: US street address with city and state or ZIP, e.g. "701 Bourbon St, New Orleans, LA 70116". "lat,lon" also works.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, instead of an address.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative west), with latitude.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres, 50 to 2000. Default 500.

name: flood_zone_nearby
title: Flood zones near an address
